markdownEditor.sampleMarkdown:
# ClientKit Markdown Editor

**ClientKit** is a collection of safe tools that run entirely in your browser.

## Features

- Real-time preview
- GitHub Flavored Markdown support
- One-click conversion to `HTML`

## Sample

1. Table

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Secure | No data is ever sent to a server |
| Fast | Everything runs in your browser |

2. Task list

- [x] Write some Markdown
- [ ] Check the preview

> Blockquotes are supported too.

Take a look at [ClientKit](https://clientkit.dev).

harAnalyzer.safetyNote: HAR files are analyzed entirely in your browser. Your data is never sent to an external server.

errors.invalidJson: Couldn't read this as JSON. The file may be corrupted or not a HAR file.
errors.invalidStructure: This doesn't look like a HAR file. Please choose a file that contains "log.entries".
errors.empty: This HAR file doesn't contain any requests.

score.title: Overall health score
score.summary: Found {errors} error(s), {slow} slow request(s), and {security} security issue(s).

errorsTab.description: Requests that returned a 4xx or 5xx status code.
errorsTab.advice4xx: 4xx errors often mean a problem with the request path, parameters, or credentials. Check the URL and whether any tokens have expired.
errorsTab.advice5xx: 5xx errors indicate a server-side problem. Check the server logs, or retry after some time.

performanceTab.description: Detects slow-responding requests as well as uncompressed or oversized resources.
performanceTab.slowEmpty: No requests took longer than 1 second.
performanceTab.adviceSlow: A long TTFB (time to first byte) points to server-side processing; a long download time points to resource size. Investigate accordingly.
performanceTab.issuesEmpty: No compression or size issues were found.
performanceTab.adviceUncompressed: Enabling compression such as gzip or Brotli can significantly reduce the transfer size of text-based resources.
performanceTab.adviceLarge: Resources larger than 500KB were found. Consider compressing images or using code splitting / lazy loading.

securityTab.description: Checks whether key security headers are applied and detects non-HTTPS traffic.
securityTab.targetNote: Checked against the response headers of the main document.
securityTab.insecureEmpty: All traffic was sent over HTTPS.
securityTab.adviceInsecure: HTTP traffic can be intercepted or tampered with. Switch all traffic to HTTPS.

adviceMissing.Content-Security-Policy: Setting a CSP (Content-Security-Policy) reduces the risk of XSS and other unauthorized script execution.
adviceMissing.Strict-Transport-Security: Setting HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security) prevents HTTP connections and always enforces HTTPS.
adviceMissing.X-Frame-Options: Setting X-Frame-Options helps prevent clickjacking attacks.
adviceMissing.X-Content-Type-Options: Setting X-Content-Type-Options helps prevent MIME-type sniffing attacks.
adviceMissing.Referrer-Policy: Setting a Referrer-Policy helps prevent information leaks via the referrer.

resourcesTab.description: See the file size and request count ratio broken down by resource type.
